highlights: ideal for landlords and first time buyers
description:
Fully refurbished and available with no onward chain. Spacious throughout with good sized kitchen and gardens, this home is perfect for first time buyers and landlords. The property is also situated within a popular residential location close to local amenities and shops. The accommodation comprises: entrance hallway, living room and good sized kitchen/dining room. To the first floor are two bedrooms and a bathroom. Externally the property has great sized gardens. To the front and side the garden is enclosed by wall and laid to lawn with pathway. To the rear the garden is again enclosed and laid to lawn. There is also on street parking to the front.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY Entered via UPVC front door.

LIVING ROOM 17' 5" x 13' 10" (5.31m x 4.22m) With windows to both the front and rear.

KITCHEN/DINING ROOM 17' 6" x 15' 4" (5.33m x 4.67m) Spacious room with windows to the side and rear and door to the rear. With fitted units, tiled splashbacks, sink unit, space for appliances and space for dining furniture.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING

Access to upstairs accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE 17' 7" x 12' 11" (5.36m x 3.94m) Windows to the front and rear and storage cupboard.

BEDROOM TWO 13' 10" x 12' 11" (4.22m x 3.94m) Window to side.

BATHROOM Partially tiled with window to rear and fitted with suite comprising: bath with over head shower, toilet and sink.

EXTERNALLY

The property has great sized gardens. To the front and side the garden is enclosed by wall and laid to lawn with pathway. To the rear the garden is again enclosed and laid to lawn. There is also on street parking to the front.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
